University Result System using Namespaces

Problem Statement:
You are required to design a program that demonstrates the use of:

Custom namespaces

The std namespace

Name conflict resolution

🔹 Requirements

Create two namespaces:

1️⃣ Internal

Function:

int marks(int m1, int m2);

Returns sum of internal marks.

2️⃣ External

Function:

int marks(int m1, int m2);

Returns sum of external marks.

⚠ Both namespaces contain a function with the same name marks().

🔹 In main()

Use using namespace std;

Take input:

internal1 internal2
external1 external2

Call both namespace functions explicitly using:

Internal::marks()
External::marks()

Print:

Internal Total: <value>
External Total: <value>
Grand Total: <value>

🔹 Input Format
i1 i2
e1 e2
